meta.title: Live captions
meta.description: Turns the audio your computer is playing plus the microphone into live multilingual subtitles. Recognition runs on this machine with a local SenseVoice model (about 230 MB downloaded on the first Start, from hf-mirror in mainland China, then cached; audio is never uploaded). Each line is translated into the language you pick and floats in a draggable caption box. Translation can use the cloud default model, a built-in offline multilingual model (a separate one-time download of about 600 MB), or your own Ollama / LM Studio server. Open it from the "Live captions" pill at the bottom right of the UI; one click writes meeting minutes at the end of a meeting (always with the cloud model). Windows only — capture uses WASAPI loopback — and do not enable it together with the bundled Voice input plugin.
